overview.zh-Hans: 该模块用于在阿里云 Stack 上创建PolarDB实例、数据库、账号、备份策略和连接配置。支持创建新实例或使用已有实例。
overview.en-US: This module is used to create PolarDB instances, databases, accounts, backup policies, and connection configurations on Alibaba Cloud Stack. Supports creating new instances or using existing ones.

description.en-US: Terraform module for creating PolarDB instances, databases, accounts, backup policies, and connection configurations
